c69fb05540.q: How does Ron Lovett gamify company values in his organizations?
c69fb05540.a: Ron Lovett gamifies values by pushing out one value every two weeks and rewarding employees with ballot entries for taking photos with the value card or writing it out. Additional ballots are earned for including coworkers, and prizes are drawn every two weeks. When collective participation hits 300 ballots, more significant prizes are awarded. This approach replaced command-and-control directives and allows values to create their own stories, connections, and fun among employees rather than top-down mandates from the C-suite.
